summary: Frontend-only Lux/Afinity theme verification on /admin and /dashboard while public pages remain TuneProtect-styled. All acceptance criteria met. 100% pass on 30+ UI assertions covering admin shell (sidebar sections, afinity-logo, signed-in card, footer, stat tiles, quick links, active-nav accent), 10 admin sub-routes regression, customer dashboard restyle, and PolicyCard preservation. Public pages (/, /products, /login) confirmed unchanged (no .lux-bg, TuneProtect brand intact).

issues: The 'Welcome back, Admin Root' green toast briefly overlaps the top-right Signed-in card on first load; visual only, the card itself is rendered correctly and becomes fully visible after toast auto-dismiss. Consider raising z-index of toast above signed-in card or anchoring toast to bottom-right to avoid overlap.

critical_code_review_comments: AdminLayout.jsx leaves an empty <div className='min-w-0' /> placeholder in the top header strip (lines 106-109) intended for per-page eyebrow+h1 — currently unused. Either delete the stub or wire it via a context/prop so individual admin pages can inject their own page title block consistently (today AdminDashboard renders its own welcome card, but other admin pages won't get the standardised eyebrow/h1 treatment).

Dashboard.jsx still mixes the old design system (bg-gradient-to-br from-primary-50, rounded-3xl, font-display) with the new lux classes in the AI recommendations + 'Recent activity' + 'My Policies' headings. For visual consistency consider migrating those secondary panels to .lux-card / .lux-eyebrow / font-lux as well.

Hydration console warning observed (`<span> cannot be a child of <option>` on Settings page) originates from Emergent's x-component source-tagging instrumentation injecting <span> into <option>, NOT from this theme PR — pre-existing and unrelated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Lux theme verified end-to-end. Admin shell uses dark sidebar (.lux-sidebar) with sectioned NAV (Workspace/Sales & CRM/Operations/Integrations), gold AfinityLogo, .lux-signed-in card, .lux-footer. Cream body via .lux-bg. Customer /dashboard wraps in .lux-bg, lux welcome panel, 4 .lux-card stats, and PolicyCard credit-card visuals preserved (2 cards rendered for demo user). Public pages (/, /products, /login) confirmed without .lux-bg and retaining TuneProtect lockup + MYR currency switcher + Login/Get Quote nav buttons.
